name: LLMHound P7: MCP tools with high-risk capability hints on reachable hosts
description: Advertised MCP tools whose descriptions/schemas match high-risk capability hints (declared heuristic, not proof of behavior).
query:
MATCH (m:LLMHound_MCPServer)-[:LLMHound_ProvidesTool]->(t:LLMHound_MCPTool)
WHERE any(x IN t.capability_hint WHERE x IN ['shell','filesystem','secrets','code'])
MATCH (m)-[:LLMHound_ObservedAt]->(h)
WHERE NOT h:LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint
RETURN m, t, h
LIMIT 100
